prompt: How do I add a shared mailbox in Outlook?
completion:
Below is a quick‑reference guide to adding a **shared mailbox** in Outlook on the most common platforms.  
(If you don’t see the options listed, check that you have *Full Access* permission on the mailbox – your Exchange or Office 365 admin must grant it first.)

---

## 1️⃣ Prerequisites

| What you need | How to verify |
|---------------|---------------|
| **Full‑Access permission** to the shared mailbox | Admin → Exchange Admin Center → Recipients → Mailboxes → *Shared mailbox* → *Mailbox delegation* → “Full Access”. |
| **Mailbox exists** (or will be created by admin) | Admin → Exchange Admin Center → Recipients → Mailboxes → “+” → “Shared mailbox”. |
| **You’re signed into Outlook** with an Exchange / Office 365 account. | Check the account in the **File → Account Settings → Account Settings** window. |

---

## 2️⃣ Outlook for Windows (Desktop)

> **Version note:** The steps are identical from Outlook 2016 up to the newest Outlook for Microsoft 365. If you see “Add shared mailbox” under File → Account Settings, you’re in the right place.

### 2.1 Quick‑Add (auto‑detect)

1. **Open Outlook.**  
2. Click your **profile name** (top‑right, near the envelope icon).  
3. Choose **Open another mailbox…**  
4. Type the **email address** (or mailbox name) of the shared mailbox and click **Open**.  
   *Your mailbox should appear instantly in the folder pane.*

### 2.2 Manual Add (via Account Settings)

1. **File → Account Settings → Account Settings…**  
2. On the **Email** tab, double‑click your Exchange/Office 365 account.  
3. Click **More Settings…**  
4. Go to the **Advanced** tab.  
5. Under **Mailboxes**, click **Add…**  
6. Enter the **display name** of the shared mailbox (you can type the email address if you prefer) and click **OK**.  
7. Click **Apply → OK → Close**.  
8. Restart Outlook if the mailbox doesn’t appear immediately.

> *Tip:* The mailbox will stay linked until you remove it from the list (same Advanced tab → “Remove” button).

---

## 3️⃣ Outlook for Mac (2016+)

1. **Tools → Accounts…**  
2. Select your Exchange/Office 365 account on the left.  
3. Click the **+** button at the bottom‑left and choose **Exchange**.  
4. In the pop‑up, type the **email address** of the shared mailbox, then click **Add**.  
5. Once added, the mailbox will appear under the **Shared** section in the folder list.

> *If you’re on Outlook 2021 or the new Mac app, the “Shared” area appears automatically when you’re granted permission.*

---

## 4️⃣ Outlook on the Web (OWA)

1. Log in to Outlook Web (outlook.office.com).  
2. Click your **profile picture** (top‑right).  
3. Choose **Open another mailbox…**  
4. Type the mailbox address or name and click **Open**.  
5. The shared mailbox opens in a new tab; you can pin it to the side bar for quick access.

> *Alternatively:* Hover over the **Folders** pane → click **+ Add shared mailbox**.

---

## 5️⃣ Outlook for iOS / Android

> **Shared mailboxes aren’t supported as a separate folder** on mobile Outlook.  
> Instead, your mailbox is automatically available once you have Full Access permission.  
> If you’re not seeing it, try:  
> * Sign out → Sign back in.  
> * Clear the app cache (Android) or delete & reinstall (iOS).  
> * Make sure you’re connected to the correct Exchange/Office 365 domain.

---

## 6️⃣ Troubleshooting Checklist

| Issue | Possible Fix |
|-------|--------------|
| Mailbox doesn’t appear after adding | Verify Full‑Access permission; try “Open another mailbox” again; restart Outlook. |
| Folder list shows *Hidden* mailboxes | In Outlook 2016+, go to **File → Options → Mail** → under *Other Mail* click **Manage Personal Folders** → uncheck **Hide shared folders**. |
| Permission denied error | Contact your Exchange/Office 365 admin; they must assign Full‑Access to your user account. |
| Out of sync / missing emails | Ensure you’re on the same mailbox (not an alias); clear the Outlook cache (`Outlook → Options → Advanced → Outlook Data File Settings → Compact Now`). |

---

## 7️⃣ Quick Reference Cheat‑Sheet

| Platform | Key Command |
|----------|-------------|
| Windows Desktop | **File → Account Settings → More Settings → Advanced → Mailboxes → Add** |
| Mac Desktop | **Tools → Accounts → + → Exchange → [shared mailbox]** |
| Outlook Web | **Profile → Open another mailbox** |
| Mobile | *Automatically visible once granted permission* |

That’s all you need to get a shared mailbox into your Outlook client. Happy emailing!
